Dear {vendor} team,

I am writing to dispute charges on {agreement}. Our commitment under this agreement covers {contracted_seats} seats, but {invoices} bills us for {billed_seats} seats. That is {extra_seats} seats more than the commitment, billed at {price_per_seat}.

The agreement states: "{increase_requires}". We have not signed any written order form increasing our seat count, so the additional seats were not authorized under the agreement.

The overcharge to date is {overcharged_to_date}, and it adds {overcharge_monthly} each month the seats remain on our bill, which is {annualized} per year at the current rate.

Please issue a credit for the overcharged amount of {overcharged_to_date} and send a corrected invoice reflecting {contracted_seats} seats going forward. Please confirm once the credit and corrected bill are in place.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,
{sender}
